question: Which films have never been rented? List the titles.
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE film_id NOT IN (SELECT i.film_id FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id)

question: How many films are longer than the average film length?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film WHERE length > (SELECT avg(length) FROM film)

question: Which actors have appeared in more than 35 films? Give first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id HAVING count(*) > 35

question: How many rentals were returned later than the film's rental duration allows?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id WHERE r.return_date IS NOT NULL AND julianday(r.return_date) - julianday(r.rental_date) > f.rental_duration

question: Which category has the highest average rental rate?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fc.film_id GROUP BY c.category_id ORDER BY avg(f.rental_rate) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers have made more than 40 rentals?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM rental GROUP BY customer_id HAVING count(*) > 40)

question: Which city has the store with id 2?
gold_sql: SELECT ci.city FROM store s JOIN address a ON a.address_id = s.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id WHERE s.store_id = 2

question: What is the total revenue from films rated G?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id WHERE f.rating = 'G'

question: List the 4 customers with the fewest rentals, with their rental counts.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, count(*) FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY count(*) LIMIT 4

question: In how many different countries do customers live?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT ci.country_id) FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id

question: Hangi filmler 'Comedy' kategorisinde ve 90 dakikadan kısa? Başlıkları listele.
gold_sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Comedy' AND f.length < 90

question: Mağaza başına kaç film kopyası var?
gold_sql: SELECT store_id, count(*) FROM inventory GROUP BY store_id

question: En çok ödeme yapan 5 müşterinin adı soyadı ne?
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY sum(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Ağustos 2005'te kaç farklı müşteri film kiraladı?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM rental WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', rental_date) = '2005-08'

question: Hiç kiralama yapmamış müşteri var mı? Kaç tane?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customer WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM rental)

question: What are the titles of films that do not feature any actors?
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE film_id NOT IN (SELECT film_id FROM film_actor)

question: Which film has the largest number of actors?
gold_sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which actors have appeared in films from more than 10 different categories? Give first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = fa.film_id GROUP BY a.actor_id HAVING count(DISTINCT fc.category_id) > 10

question: Which film generated the highest total rental revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT f.title FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id ORDER BY sum(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 1
